questions: Is a route the same in both directions, so Circle to Madina and Madina to Circle cost the same, or should each direction have its own fare?
Should only station staff be able to add routes and change fares, with a login, while passengers can only look fares up?
If there is no direct route between two stops, should the system add up fares across connecting routes, or just say there is no route?
answers: Same fare both ways. One route covers both directions, so Circle to Madina and Madina to Circle cost the same.
Just say there is no route (not found, 404). Only direct routes count, and fares are never combined across connecting routes.
